description: AI Agents (inside one system): Use when the person asks for this in a system whose AI agent may change records: A note on a record's timeline in the person's system. Give one item per record, at most 25. Nothing is written yet: the answer shows, per record, what it holds now and would hold after, plus a proposal id. Show it to the person, say so first when something would be sent to the people in their system, ask whether to go ahead, and only then call apply_proposal; when needsApproval is true, share the approve link instead. Not for reading (use search_records or get_record).

items.description: One object per record, at most 25.

at.description: When the note is from, ISO 8601 in UTC; now when left out.

id.description: The id of that record in the system.

type.description: The type of the record the note goes on.

user.description: The id of the user shown as its writer, as describe_record_type gives it with include users.

system.description: Which AI agent: the system's id from get_ai_agent_options, or the name of the system or its connection. Ask the person which AI agent they mean unless they named it in this conversation; never pick one yourself.
